analysis: Isolated, all-active, linear single-Plate modal audit of compiled 32x32 masked topology; no alternate solver or DSP transform.

sourceEquations.laplacian: L has diagonal -4 and +1 for each in-mask four-neighbor; missing-mask neighbors contribute zero.
sourceEquations.poles: p^2-a*p+(1-d)=0; underdamped radius=sqrt(1-d), angle=acos(a/(2*radius)), f=angle*6000/(2*pi), tau=-1/(6000*ln(radius)).
sourceEquations.contactInput: Worklet subtracts this step force from previous before recurrence; this produces input gain (1-d). The same factor multiplies every pulse sample and cancels in pulse/instant-impulse ratios.
sourceEquations.pulseRatio: At pole p, post-pulse free-wave coefficient relative to a unit first-step impulse of equal total force is abs(sum_k e[k]*p^(-k)); envelope-only spectral magnitude is abs(F(angle)).

interpretationLimits: The same 18-step envelope is common to all Plates; evaluated attenuation varies with each topology's pole frequencies.

Geometry changes the eigenvalue spectrum; material coefficients also change poles. The shared-median rerun holds material constant to show geometry-only spread, while native rows combine geometry and each frozen descriptor.

The four-neighbor mask graph is bipartite: -L=4I-A and A has eigenvalues paired as +/-mu. Thus the -L spectrum is symmetric around q=4 and every mask's median q is 4; a shared-material median pole is equal by construction and does not imply identical geometry.
Mode counts and quantiles are not excitation weights. A mode contributes to observed output only through the strike footprint's modal projection and the pickup's modal projection.

Relative damping correction can look large when the envelope response nearly cancels: the native-material maximum is -84.09 dB envelope-only to -67.26 dB damped (+16.83 dB); the shared-median-material maximum is -98.53 to -67.34 dB (+31.19 dB). Both remain deeply attenuated in absolute amplitude; typical correction is about +0.028 dB.

This omits active-node sleep/wake, stateful local contact compliance, cross-Plate and nodule coupling, and actual multi-event histories. It does not establish audibility or audible modal individuality.

claimBoundary.implementedFact: The worklet sends the 18 normalized half-sine force samples before the unchanged second-order Plate recurrence.
claimBoundary.computedResult: Natural selected descriptors have density fixed at 1.2; stiffness and damping are perfectly correlated in the 100-row frozen current-law corpus. Across 12 isolated topologies, each mode's pulse coefficient depends on the 18-sample transfer evaluated at its recurrence pole.
claimBoundary.inference: The envelope can strongly shape which linear Plate modes receive excitation. Geometry changes the full mode distribution and eigenvectors, while the fixed -4 diagonal forces the median -L eigenvalue to 4; natural material contributes a small pole shift in this narrow selected range.
claimBoundary.notEstablished: The modal calculation does not establish excitation strength for any mode in a real strike, audibility, perceived timbral individuality, or behavior of the full coupled sleeping worklet.

selfCheck: passed: 18 samples, unit DC sum, attenuated Nyquist, force-before-recurrence impulse gain and damped pole-projection identity.
